description: This is a Java source file containing integration tests for Entity DataTable Checks within the Apache Fineract project. It includes test cases for creating, deleting, and retrieving entity datatable checks, as well as testing with different entity types like clients, groups, savings, and loans. The file also manages setup procedures and utility methods for creating related entities and datatables.

classes.name: EntityDatatableChecksIntegrationTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the creation, deletion, and retrieval of entity datatable checks in Apache Fineract's integration test suite.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST API specifications and helper objects before each test.

methods.name: validateCreateDeleteDatatableCheck
methods.description: Tests creation and deletion of a datatable and its associated entity datatable check.

methods.name: validateCreateDeleteEntityDatatableCheck
methods.description: Repeated test for creating and deleting an entity datatable check and associated datatable.

methods.name: validateRetriveEntityDatatableChecksList
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the list of entity datatable checks.

methods.name: validateCreateClientWithEntityDatatableCheck
methods.description: Creates a datatable and associated check, then creates a client with the datatable, and cleans up.

methods.name: validateCreateClientWithEntityDatatableCheckWithFailure
methods.description: Tests failure cases when creating a client with a datatable that triggers validation errors.

methods.name: validateCreateGroupWithEntityDatatableCheck
methods.description: Creates a group entity with datatable check, verifies, and cleans up.

methods.name: validateCreateGroupWithEntityDatatableCheckWithFailure
methods.description: Tests failure scenario for creating a group with datatable check.

methods.name: validateCreateSavingsWithEntityDatatableCheck
methods.description: Creates savings account with datatable check, verifies, and cleans up.

methods.name: validateCreateSavingsWithEntityDatatableCheckWithFailure
methods.description: Tests failure in creating savings application with datatable validation error.

methods.name: validateCreateLoanWithEntityDatatableCheck
methods.description: Creates loan with datatable check, verifies, and cleanup.

methods.name: validateCreateLoanWithEntityDatatableCheckWithFailure
methods.description: Tests failure scenario in loan application with datatable validation.

methods.name: createSavingsProduct
methods.description: Helper method to create a savings product with various parameters.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan product with specified parameters.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplication
methods.description: Helper method to submit a loan application including collateral setup.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplicationWithError
methods.description: Helper method to simulate and retrieve errors when applying for a loan.

methods.name: createClientWithDatatableUsingEntitySubtype
methods.description: Creates a client with datatable columns of subtype PERSON and ENTITY, then creates the client with datatable values.
